source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.02.2026 (6. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Неки присутни велмож Теофил насмеје се на ове речи па довикну Доротеји: „Чуј, невесто Христова, пошаљи ми јабука и цвећа од шипака из Раја твога женика!“ … И он би мучен и убијен за Христа.“

attestations.note: Read from the Prologue text on the page, not from its entry list. He has no entry of his own there: he is named inside the day's third entry, Dorothea's. Three differences from the Russian life, all recorded and none resolved: he is a велмож, a nobleman standing by, not a scholastic; what he asks for is apples and pomegranate flowers, and what the angel brings is three apples and three red pomegranate flowers, where the Russian life has roses; and the Prologue says the season was winter, which is what makes the gift a wonder. The Prologue has him tortured and killed for Christ without naming the manner, where the Russian life has him beheaded. It gives no year.

death.note: The Sretensky life: «пострадала при императоре Диоклитиане в 288 или 300 году». Two years are offered and neither is preferred, so the interval holds both; the day's own line prints the same pair as «(288-300)».
